Community-Led Conservation and Restoration 

Throughout the project, Barangay Dulao residents will lead efforts to restore and protect their 129-hectare watershed alongside infrastructure improvements. Reforestation will focus on degraded areas, with each of the community’s 300 residents pledging to plant at least 10 trees yearly, contributing a minimum of 3,000 trees. To further safeguard the watershed, residents will maintain firebreaks along mountain ridges before the peak fire season, helping prevent wildfires from spreading into protected forest areas.
